prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text:
There was a provision for credit losses of $443,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to a negative $269,000 provision for credit losses for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The $443,000 provision for credit losses consisted of a negative $128,000 provision related to loans and a provision related to unfunded commitments of $571,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026. During the three months ended September 30, 2026, the decrease was primarily due to decreases in qualitative factors. The provision for credit losses related to unfunded loan commitments for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was due primarily to an increase of construction and commercial real estate loans in the loan pipeline balance at quarter end.

The provision is primarily a function of the Company's reserving methodology and assessments of certain quantitative and qualitative factors which are used to determine an appropriate allowance for credit losses for the period. See further discussion regarding the allowance for loan losses in the "Asset Quality" section for an analysis of charge-offs, nonperforming assets, specific reserves and additional provisions and the "Allowance for Credit Loss" section.

nonint.text: Total other noninterest expense increased $537,000 to $1.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $1.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase primarily related to an increase in loan sale loss provision for a pool of loans identified with an additional risk for buybacks.

nonop.text: Total other noninterest expense increased $537,000 to $1.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $1.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase primarily related to an increase in loan sale loss provision for a pool of loans identified with an additional risk for buybacks.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: Income tax expense totaled $1.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $1.9 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease was primarily due to the decrease in pre-tax income. Income tax expense was recognized on the statement of income during the three months ended September 30, 2026 at an effective rate of 18.8% of pretax income compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025 at an effective rate of 19.5% of pretax income.

net.text: Net loss totaled $474,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to a net income of $948,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. We originated $509.7 million in mortgage loans held for sale (including sales to the community banking segment) during the three months ended September 30, 2026, which represents a decrease of $29.7 million, or 5.5%, from the $539.4 million originated during the three months ended September 30, 2025. Origination volume relative to purchase activity accounted for 90.4% of originations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to 90.1% of total originations for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Total mortgage banking noninterest income decreased $2.8 million, or 13.4%, to $18.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $21.0 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease in mortgage banking noninterest income was related to a decrease in gross margin on loans originated and sold for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to September 30, 2025. Gross margin on loans originated and sold is the ratio of mortgage banking income (excluding the change in interest rate lock fair value) divided by total loan originations. We sell loans on both a servicing-released and a servicing-retained basis.

Net interest income.text: Our community banking segment generates the significant majority of our consolidated net interest income and requires the significant majority of our provision for loan losses. Our mortgage banking segment generates the significant majority of our noninterest income and a majority of our noninterest expenses. We have provided below a discussion of the material results of operations for each segment on a separate basis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, which focuses on noninterest income and noninterest expenses. We have also provided a discussion of the consolidated operations of the Company, which includes the consolidated operations of the Bank and Waterstone Mortgage Corporation, for the same periods.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text: Total noninterest income decreased $3.0 million, or 13.5%, to $19.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $22.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025.

lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Deposits
lines.why: Customers' money a bank holds is its business: operating.
